scene: At the top of the steps, a bustling mountain transit terrace awaits.
picture: Flat side view on a mountain transit terrace. Far left stands a brass spiral lift with an open gate. Left of centre sits a wooden cable tram. Right of centre, the woman in lilac headscarf and mustard coat steps onto stone flags. Far right waits a brightly polished, glass-roofed trolley.
shown: A brass spiral lift cage with open grate doors stands far left.
A wooden mountain cable tram waits on iron rails left of centre.
A small glass-roofed trolley with cushioned seats waits on tracks far right.
